entities.summary: Fander Falconí Benitez, is an Ecuadorian economist and politician. He served as Foreign Minister in the government of President Rafael Correa from December 2008 until his resignation on 13 January 2010 because of the Yasuní oil project.

entities.summary: Fander Falconí Benitez, is an Ecuadorian economist and politician. He served as Foreign Minister in the government of President Rafael Correa from December 2008 until his resignation on 13 January 2010 because of the Yasuní oil project.
